action: Clicked Add track then Add instrument track.
observed: Starting project already contains Circuit drums audio clip. Browser shows R1 Drums, R1 Mini and R1 Sampler, while top count says 0 plug-ins.
discovery: Add track is easy to find; instrument names do not identify bass immediately.

expectation: Find a ready-to-use bass tone without knowing synthesizer settings.
action: Selected R1 Mini and Add instrument track, opened preset dropdown.
observed: Large panel initially has Custom preset and many unfamiliar oscillator/envelope controls. Dropdown offers Bass Rubber Bass and Bass Acid Line. Selected Rubber Bass.
discovery: Musical preset names solve the instrument-choice uncertainty.

expectation: Open the New pattern rectangle to enter notes.
action: Closed instrument panel and double-clicked auto-created New pattern.
observed: New instrument track includes one-bar pattern automatically.

expectation: Double-click pattern opens notes; Keyboard likely means musical keys.
action: Double-clicked pattern twice, renamed it Bass riff, clicked Keyboard; canceled and right-clicked pattern.
observed: Double-click opened rename form. Keyboard revealed typing keyboard, not music keys. Right-click exposed Edit notes as first menu item.
discovery: Recovered through context menu after about a minute.
issue: The natural open gesture led to naming rather than entering music, and Keyboard wording briefly reinforced the wrong path.

expectation: Use the piano layout to place a low C minor riff.
action: Scrolled down six notches, chose Pencil, dragged four quarter notes in the first bar.
observed: Notes labeled C2, C2, D#2, G2 appeared with lengths corresponding to the drags. Clip end label at bar 2 shows one-bar source, while page displays four bars.
discovery: Pencil hint Draw notes / Drag to set length makes entry understandable. Scrolling directly changes pitch range.

expectation: Play starts the riff and advances the timeline.
action: Clicked Play and checked again about 12 seconds later.
observed: Play changed to Pause; transport remained 1.1.1 / 0:00.00 and playhead at start. No sound has been verified.
issue: Cannot audition while composing; reported possible environment cause to coordinator.

expectation: Loop this clip might make repeated riff blocks.
action: Stopped, returned to arranger, right-clicked Loop this clip, then chose Duplicate toolbar and clicked successive clips.
observed: Loop this clip shortened the green playback region to one bar. Duplicate became a tool and showed Click a clip to duplicate. Clicking successive clips made four adjacent Bass riff blocks.
discovery: Duplicate hint clarified tool-mode behavior and repeating phrase was quick afterward.

expectation: Use another instrument track for the higher line.
action: Added second R1 Mini, chose Lead Sync Lead, named clip High melody, used right-click Edit notes. Drew five notes in bar one then three notes in bar two.
observed: Second clip opened around C4/C5 automatically instead of bass pitch range. Drawing past clip end automatically extended source from one to two bars.
discovery: Two registers are easy to distinguish in piano editor and source length grows naturally.

action: Responded to bottom Audio output stream failed banner with Retry playback; opened Details then Audio setup.
observed: Retry failed; Details says audio output stream failed/disconnected and ALSA I/O error (5). Setup output offers System default or Rill lab paced output. Chose the only alternative and Apply. Error banner disappeared and Pause state appeared.
discovery: Error supplies relevant recovery buttons and concrete next step.
limitation: Likely environment/audio device issue; actual music not yet heard or verified. Coordinator separately reports nonzero signal in recording, which does not establish transport playback.

expectation: Repeat the two-bar melody to match four bass bars, then lower melody and drums.
action: Duplicated melody once. Dragged green loop end toward bar five twice. Opened Mixer, dragged lead and drums faders, clicked lead numeric level and typed -8.
observed: Melody doubled to four bars. First loop drag ended at 4.3.3, a little short of intended end. Mixer clearly exposes channel faders. Lead changed to -11.5 dB from drag, corrected to -8 with numeric entry; drums -10, bass remains -2.5.
discovery: Numeric level click allows precise direct entry, useful after coarse fader movement.
limitation: These are provisional balances without audible verification.

expectation: Save as should make an editable project copy.
action: File > Save as; entered full assigned exports path C-minor-guitarist-idea.rill.
observed: Dialog closed, title changed to C-minor-guitarist-idea and unsaved marker disappeared.
discovery: File menu has familiar Save as and clearly named Export WAV.

expectation: Export audio creates a file that can be listened to later even if playback is unavailable.
action: File > Export WAV, kept defaults Mix/WAV/32-bit float/Follow audio setup/Arrangement/include effect tails.
observed: Export dialog shows 0:08.571 arrangement duration plus tails. Sample format and dithering are unfamiliar; defaults seem safest.

expectation: Save dialog completes audio export and offers a way to check it.
action: Accepted default filename in already-correct exports folder, waited, clicked Play in completed banner.
observed: Exported C-minor-guitarist-idea.wav appeared with checkmark, Play, Copy path, Dismiss. Play vanished after click; no visible player or timeline movement followed.
discovery: Export completion gives clear file name and success feedback.
limitation: Audio content not personally heard; audition behavior may be environment-confounded.

expectation: Give the two instrument tracks meaningful names.
action: Double-clicked bass mixer header, chose Track tab, attempted typing into Name, changed color blue. Reopened after name stayed unchanged; Keyboard opened rename form, where typing plus Apply name succeeded. Used lead header right-click Rename to rename High lead. Saved with Ctrl+S and returned to arranger.
observed: Final arranger has Rubber bass and High lead names, four bars of each part, green playback range 1.1 to5.1, and no unsaved marker.
discovery: Mixer header context menu provides direct Rename route. Track color propagates to clips.
limitation: Coordinator later identified Xvfb focus problem after native pickers and corrected driver. Ignored name typing is environment-confounded, not reliable evidence of an application defect.

expectation: Preserve a short musical sketch that can be refined later.
action: Ended at saved arrangement after about sixteen minutes.
observed: Four-note C2 C2 D#2 G2 bass pattern repeated four times; eight-note C4/D#4/G4/A#4/G4/C5/A#4/G4 melody repeated twice; existing drum loop retained. Mixer levels visually confirmed. Project and WAV file names and nonzero sizes confirmed only as artifact bookkeeping.
outcome: Creation, provisional balance, project save and WAV export succeeded; reliable audition and actual sonic balance remain unverified.
